title: AgentHive Platform SLA Contract
description: Service Level Agreement defining operational targets, failure modes, and recovery procedures for the AgentHive autonomous agent platform

postgres.description: PostgreSQL database connectivity and query latency (agenthive + tenant DBs)

control_plane.description: Proposal state transitions and orchestrator decision loop latency

proposal_workflow.description: Successful proposal state transitions (Draft → Review → Develop → Merge → Complete)

platform_availability.description: Baseline capacity for simultaneous agent dispatch and execution

normal.description: All systems nominal. Proposal lifecycle operating within SLA.

triggers: Single worker agent unresponsive for >60 seconds
Lease timeout rate spike >5% over baseline
degraded.escalation_path: Alert roadmap_notify channel; page on-call operator if >5 min sustained
degraded.description: Partial degradation. Proposal lifecycle may experience delays; critical workflows proceeding.

triggers: MCP server not responding for >5 minutes
PostgreSQL connection pool exhausted or down
All worker agents unreachable or timed out
down.escalation_path: PagerDuty critical alert; invoke incident commander; attempt remediation checklist
remediation_checklist: Verify service health: systemctl status agenthive-orchestrator agenthive-mcp
Review orchestrator logs for crash dumps or deadlock signatures
Inspect pgbouncer state: pgbouncer_admin.txt for pool saturation
If corrupted proposal state: use proposal_audit_log to rollback; file incident report
Restart services: sudo systemctl restart agenthive-orchestrator agenthive-mcp
Verify agency liaisons re-register with agent_registry
Smoke test: dispatch pilot proposal through full workflow
down.description: Critical service outage. Proposal lifecycle halted; recovery required.

alert_rules.name: agency_session_orphan
alert_rules.condition: agency_session.bootLiaison NULL and created_at > 15 minutes ago

alert_rules.name: message_channel_mismatch
alert_rules.condition: NOTIFY channel schema_a and LISTEN channel_b incompatible (detected via handler crash)

failure_modes.notes: Process exits non-zero; systemd restarts every 10s. Check: UUID/bigint handler, implicit gate spawn, fresh-worktree CLI vs HEAD mismatch. P1386/P1408 root causes documented.

Process running but decision loop does not emit dispatch. Symptoms: proposal queue age climbing, no new agenda rows. Check: deadlock in PG, blocked on liaison-message LISTEN, or LLM hanging. Circuit-breaker: gate-paused respect (P1393) + lease_expired exclusion (P1406).

pgbouncer waiting_clients ≥ 10 or connection error. Typical cause: long-running query, FK scan, or trigger cascade. Kill slow queries; add index if needed. See a2a-host audit (2026-05-23) for schema drift + PGUSER interaction.

Constraint violation, orphaned row, or trigger side-effect gone wrong. Use proposal_audit_log and agent_activity_log to identify corrupted txn. Rollback via SQL; file incident. Example: proposal_lease.is_active generated column silent-drift on TTL change (feedback_generated_columns_silent_drift.md).

Tool registered in server.ts but not in tools/agents/index.ts (FS branch), or vice versa. Symptom: 'Tool not found' in client logs. Fix: grep action name in both locations; rebuild with 'npm run build:server'. See feedback_mcp_pg_vs_fs_tool_registration.md.

Two NOTIFY triggers emit to same channel with incompatible payloads. Handler crashes silently; looks like pool saturation. Audit: grep NOTIFY in triggers; ensure listener can unmarshal all payloads. See channel_naming_convergence.md.

bootLiaison NULL and created_at > 15 min: prior process died ungracefully. Fix: 2 SQL UPDATEs (release lease, set NULL→timestamp) + restart. Code-level: liaisonRegister should auto-heal orphans. See liaison_orphan_session_blocker.md.

Orchestrator spawns gate agent directly instead of via dispatch loop, breaking state consistency. Symptom: proposal in REVIEW/mature but no dispatch_record. P1386 architect early-exit detects and skips; P903 consolidation scheduled. Manual fix: use release_lease() then let gate cron pick up.

Handler receives UUID column name but code expects bigint; cast error. Symptom: silent NULL in agent_spawn. P1408 pending to standardize. Workaround: verify schema matches handler expectations before dispatch.

verify_ac RPC rejects calls without verified_by field. Not documented in MCP tool PARAM-NAME GOTCHAS. Fix: always pass verified_by=<agent_registry identity>. See feedback_mcp_verify_ac_requires_verified_by.md.

mcp_proposal create fails (e.g., invalid type) but still returns a phantom ID. Downstream queries silently hit NULL. Verify create result success before advancing. See feedback_proposal_type_workflow_config.md.
Two parallel agents both 'git add <file>'; one's commit includes the other's staged changes. Use 'git commit -m "msg" -- <file>' single-step instead. See feedback_concurrent_git_add.md.

Edits to src/apps/*.ts have no effect; bundle (scripts/cli.cjs.js) not rebuilt. Run 'npm run build:web' (or build:dist for CLI). Telltale: one trace fires, adjacent one doesn't. See feedback_roadmap_bundle.md.

Spawn fails because model_routes entry missing, disabled, or cost/priority out of bounds. Resolver sorts by priority+cost; is_default flag ignored. Operator adds route or bumps priority; agents re-register on next boot. See route_resolver_is_default_gap.md and model_registration_agency_owned.md.

Proposal requires_capabilities mismatch with available agent_capability rows. Taxonomy too coarse (37 vs 15); no overlap. Operator manually assigns; P-track: hierarchical taxonomy with 100+ leaves. See project_capability_taxonomy_gap.md.
msg_send emits to a2a_msg_<to>; agency LISTEN liaison_message_<to>. Canonical-vs-fully-qualified identity mismatch in ACL. See a2a_bus_two_channel_gap.md.

msg_send metadata (role override) dropped on INSERT. Fixed in commit f9b56ede; added metadata column to message_ledger. Verify: metadata persisted in DB before trusting role. See msg_send_metadata_fixed.md.

definitions.rto: Recovery Time Objective — maximum time to restore service after failure detection
definitions.rpo: Recovery Point Objective — maximum data loss tolerance (0 = no data loss acceptable)
definitions.lease_ttl: Proposal lease time-to-live; proposal marked stale if released_at timestamp exceeds TTL without renewal
definitions.concurrent_agents_baseline: Standard capacity target; exceeding triggers scaling checks
definitions.p99_latency: 99th percentile response time; 99% of requests must complete within this threshold
definitions.availability_pct: Uptime percentage over measurement window (7-day rolling by default)
definitions.window: Time period over which metric is measured (rolling_Xday, rolling_Xhour, instantaneous)

revision_history.author: operator
